Microsoft ONNX Runtime C API headers, tag v1.23.2, MIT license (see LICENSE).

Source: https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/tree/v1.23.2/include/onnxruntime/core/session

Only headers are vendored. The optional person provider dynamically loads a
user-supplied CPU x64 runtime with C API 23 or newer. No inference binaries or
model weights are bundled. See docs/architecture/nr-person-partition.md.
